answer: How does the system spot ghosts? We dip each agent’s proof into the same hidden atoll-ripple, then scan for zenith bright zones that match our locked sonar map. A Sybil must freshly carve a new woodchip ridge for every identity, its micro-wave just 0.01° off the network’s stored topographic anchor; misalignment flags the fake in microseconds. Cost: one woodchip ridge, 14 minutes of CNC time per head, flat and unscalable.
